description:
"We're going to kindergarten, elementary school, middle school, and university together... The paladinate and the paladinate was gay?! The same kindergarten, the same elementary school, the same middle school, the same tutor, the same academy, the same weekend... In-woo's was Min-hyuk's, and Min-hyuk's was In-woo's. Why did this happen? The love fight between Hee-min and Min-hyuk begins over In-woo!"

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/love_to_love), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/bbyeotero), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000062283), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1020011834), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=11018852), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=260307)
